items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I know John and Ted Howard.

ctx.x: Regular violin, uh-huh. And mandolin and guitar. He was, he was just a genius, but not with notes. He was an air man. Just played by air man. By air man. But that's the way we were right up. We were right up until I came here and after I came here. My mother, she was a musician of two notes.

Was it your mother that was, she isn't living now, is she? No, she passed. Didn't they call her Mother Richards? That's right. Because I went to the service once. Yes, you did. At the church way downtown. Yes, you did. You were playing. I know John and Ted Howard. Yes, I was. Yes, I was. We all, we all, we all. I remember your brother, your brother Julius the one that played guitar.
